# Research leaderboard

<!-- Generated by scripts/experiments.py render. Do not edit by hand. -->

110 recorded experiment cases, including controls, retired ideas and blocked runs. Source of truth: `research/registry/experiments.jsonl`; add records with `scripts/experiments.py log`. **Compare only inside one context.** Rows are ordered by the frontier of net CAGR (higher) against max drawdown (lower), then by CAGR; Calmar and Sharpe are diagnostics and no blended score exists. `DD>30%` marks drawdown beyond the 30% mandate reassessment reference; it is a flag, not a gate. Development rows are viewed history and are not evidence of future returns; only forward, shadow, paper and live classes escape hindsight. `imported` rows come from the retired hand-edited table and keep their original evidence status; context codes and study notes for them are defined in the [archived hand-edited leaderboard](history/2026-11-09-hand-edited-leaderboard.md).
